crossRefs.note: But an angel of the Lord opened the prison doors by night, and brought them out and said,
He who sits in the heavens will laugh. The Lord will have them in derision.
Yahweh brings the counsel of the nations to nothing. He makes the thoughts of the peoples to be of no effect.
There is no wisdom nor understanding nor counsel against Yahweh.
Who is he who says, and it comes to pass, when the Lord doesn’t command it?
I called on your name, Yahweh, out of the lowest dungeon.
and whoever doesn’t fall down and worship shall be cast into the middle of a burning fiery furnace.
My God has sent his angel, and has shut the lions’ mouths, and they have not hurt me; because as before him innocence…
saying, “Sir, we remember what that deceiver said while he was still alive: ‘After three days I will rise again.’
When they were assembled with the elders, and had taken counsel, they gave a large amount of silver to the soldiers,
Therefore they took up stones to throw at him, but Jesus was hidden, and went out of the temple, having gone through…

translations.web: “We found the prison shut and locked, and the guards standing before the doors, but when we opened them, we found no one inside!”
translations.bsb: “We found the jail securely locked, with the guards posted at the doors; but when we opened them, we found no one inside.”
translations.kjv: Saying, The prison truly found we shut with all safety, and the keepers standing without before the doors: but when we had opened, we found no man within.
translations.asv: saying, The prison-house we found shut in all safety, and the keepers standing at the doors: but when we had opened, we found no man within.
